meaning: Interpretive argument that the strong per se reading is what St. Thomas meant. Lean verifies the consequence and also proves both formal premises (strongReadingYieldsUnmovedMover; weakReadingDoesNotYieldUnmovedMover by a finite model in which every being is moved). The textual premises and the charity principle remain source-fidelity and methodology claims; on reading B of q.46 a.2 ad 7 the no-counter-evidence premise fails.
